answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can anchor identities to GNSS multipath reflectometry. A node authenticates by logging carrier-phase shifts as satellites transit from the horizon to the zenith above an open terrace. An attacker must deploy discrete antenna front-ends across distinct physical sites, incurring linear hardware and spatial costs. However, severe ionospheric scintillation distorts RF propagation, causing occasional verification failures.
